类 DemoMetadata

java.lang.Object
DemoMetadata
public final class DemoMetadata extends Object
Centralises version labels and iteration notes for the demo build.

Constants in this class are displayed in the UI title bar, the "About" dialog, and generated reports. Update VERSION_LABEL and ITERATION_NOTE at the start of each release iteration. The class is not intended to be instantiated.
